name: Quantum Program Synthesis Benchmarks
description: A set of benchmark tasks and evaluations for quantum program synthesis methods and swarm algorithms.
evaluation_method: functional_correctness / task_success_rate (checking correctness/equivalence of generated quantum programs on a simulator)
notes: Specialized quantum-program tasks requiring simulators or formal equivalence checks; evaluation depends on simulator fidelity and task specification; dataset is domain-specific and not primarily aimed at general LLM evaluation.
